snippet.title: Wizdom Academy - Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Build and manage your wizard academy as the headmaster. Feel the city-building thrill of constructing your magic school. Recruit students, guide them to become wizards, control resources, customize your castle, and expand your academy's influence and prestige. Start your legacy today!

Wizdom Academy will be available in Early Access on Steam starting April 17, 2025.
